newsitem.title: USA: GRC says surveys show small initial market.
newsitem.headline: GRC says surveys show small initial market.

text.p: GRC International Inc said Friday that results from two new surveys it commissioned to quantify the commercial market opportunities for its OSU Network Interface product were consistent in the near-term outlook and revealed a small initial market for OSU.
It said the surveys differed on the long-term market opportunity.
The company said projections by industry experts forecast greater demand.
GRC provides professional services and technology solutions to comercial and government customers.
